description.value: Healthyway Natural Foods is a locally owned, family-run health food store that has been a Campbell River institution since 1993, operating from its own purpose-built downtown building since 2016. The store carries organic produce, bulk foods, supplements, local BC products, and specialty sections covering gluten-free, keto/paleo, and vegan foods. An in-house cafe rounds out the offering with coffee, smoothies, baked goods, sandwiches, and salads.
